## Premium scores spread wider

These illustrative satisfaction scores come from eight customers on each plan. The width of a shape is how common a score is, the thick bar inside is the range between the quartiles, and the dot is the median.

```chart
type: violin
title: Premium customers rate us higher and less evenly
subtitle: Satisfaction score by plan, eight customers each
data:
  inline:
    - {plan: Standard, score: 41}
    - {plan: Standard, score: 47}
    - {plan: Standard, score: 50}
    - {plan: Standard, score: 52}
    - {plan: Standard, score: 53}
    - {plan: Standard, score: 55}
    - {plan: Standard, score: 58}
    - {plan: Standard, score: 63}
    - {plan: Flex, score: 52}
    - {plan: Flex, score: 57}
    - {plan: Flex, score: 60}
    - {plan: Flex, score: 61}
    - {plan: Flex, score: 62}
    - {plan: Flex, score: 64}
    - {plan: Flex, score: 66}
    - {plan: Flex, score: 70}
    - {plan: Premium, score: 49}
    - {plan: Premium, score: 60}
    - {plan: Premium, score: 68}
    - {plan: Premium, score: 74}
    - {plan: Premium, score: 77}
    - {plan: Premium, score: 82}
    - {plan: Premium, score: 90}
    - {plan: Premium, score: 94}
encoding: {x: plan, y: score}
axes:

```

*Source: Illustrative values.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each plan's observations, median, quartiles and range.
